rule: Maximum per-record finished timestamp, falling back to started; timestamped records outrank missing/invalid timestamps. Naive timestamps use UTC+08:00. Ties: more observed mode results, then JUnit-bearing results, then delta-bearing results; explicit source priority resume rN > shardN-M > main (higher numeric generation/index wins); final tie uses canonical record SHA256. No filesystem mtime or enumeration-order overwrite.
